one_liner: Mermaid CLI (mmdc) is a local open-source renderer with no hosted API or credentials. Mermaid.ai's separate hosted REST render API (free-tier API key) and official MCP server could back a toolkit instead.
auth_notes: The CLI needs no credentials. The hosted Mermaid.ai API uses a Bearer API key created in the console. The OAuth 2.1 option in the evidence applies to the MCP server, not the REST API. The mermaid-api.readthedocs results describe an unrelated product (MERMAID coral-reef data), so I ignored them.
access_notes: The CLI is free and open-source. The hosted API works with a free Mermaid account, which gets a monthly allowance of API credits. Paid plans get a bigger allowance.
blocker_notes: Mermaid CLI itself is a local Node/Puppeteer tool with no hosted HTTP API. A toolkit would have to target the separate Mermaid.ai hosted API (credit-metered) or run the CLI in a sandbox.

evidence.quote: Any Mermaid account works, including a free one, and every account gets a monthly allowance of API credits. Paid plans include a bigger allowance.
The response is the image itself, ready to write to disk.
A local MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that renders Mermaid diagrams and returns PNG images.
